title: For Uyghurs in Central Asia, US Diplomacy Could Be a Lifeline
gist: The author urges Secretary of State Marco Rubio to publicly raise the plight of Uyghurs in Central Asia during his visit to Uzbekistan with 200+ US business leaders, citing Pompeo's 2019 and 2020 precedents. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: Marco Rubio is leading a delegation of more than 200 American business leaders to Uzbekistan, which the author sees as an opening to raise the Uyghur issue publicly.
insights.speaker: Omer Kanat
insights.so_what: US commercial engagement in Central Asia is bundled with human-rights messaging that could affect China-Central Asia dynamics.

insights.claim: Mike Pompeo's public statements in 2019 and 2020 urging Central Asian states not to send Uyghurs back to China resonated deeply with Uyghurs, who felt they had an advocate.
insights.speaker: Omer Kanat
insights.so_what: Precedent for how US messaging can shape Central Asian deportation policy.
